To Call Writer Directly: 
+1 202 389 5078 
winn.allen@kirkland.com 

1301 Pennsylvania Avenue NW 
Washington, D.C. 20004 
United States 

+1 202 389 5000 

www.kirkland.com 

August 20, 2019 

Facsimile: 
+1 202 389 5200 

Electronic Filing 

Mr. Scott Harris 
Clerk, Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, N.E. 
Washington, D.C. 20543-0001 

Re:  Holguin-Hernandez v. United States, No. 18-7739 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

As appointed amicus counsel in the above-captioned matter, I hereby request, under Rule 
30.4  of  the  Rules  of  this  Court,  an  extension  of  time  to  file  the  amicus  brief  in  support  of 
affirmance.  Currently, the amicus brief is due on September 9, 2019.  I request an extension to 
September 30, 2019.  Petitioner’s counsel and the Solicitor General have agreed to the request 
for additional time. 

This extension request is due to the press of other pending matters and professional duties 

that make the current deadline difficult to meet. 

Thank you in advance for your attention to this matter.  Please do not hesitate to contact 

me should you require additional information. 

Sincerely, 

/s/ Winn Allen 
K. Winn Allen 
Appointed Amicus Counsel 

Beijing  Boston  Chicago  Dallas  Hong Kong  Houston 

London 

Los Angeles  Munich  New York  Palo Alto  Paris  San Francisco  Shanghai
